purpose: Transport-neutral reference-only request/response/event boundary for generic Documents services consumed by System Master or peers without transferring semantic ownership.
invariants: Requests, responses and events carry artifact references and exact digests, never raw document/manuscript bytes.
The idempotency key binds the canonical semantic request digest; reuse with changed semantics is rejected.
Responses and events preserve request_id and correlation_id exactly.
Output artifacts require exact digest identity before SUCCEEDED is emitted.
FAILED and BLOCKED responses require a classified error and do not synthesize success.
Document service consumption never transfers Book, Learning, Core, Programming or retired Prose semantic ownership.
No A-01, native, publication, production, author or private authority is created by this contract.
canonicalization: Recursively sort object keys; preserve array order; JSON encode without insignificant whitespace; SHA-256 the canonical UTF-8 bytes.
idempotency: Same idempotency_key plus same canonical semantic digest is replay-safe; same key plus different semantic digest is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
